description: A refused command batch as the Shell tells the human (ticket 26/09/23 C10, audit G-P2-3; 26/09/30 NON-DESTRUCTIVE-HISTORY-EDITING follow-up 3). `rejection` is the one typed contract every producer answers (`🏪️store/🔄️sync/🧬️schema/🔣️command-rejection`): a hub refusal carries the `MutationMessage`s the hub graded it with, decoded once by the actor. The outcome step grades a region another human's concurrent command touched as `mutation.clamped` and a violated structural constraint as `mutation.invariant` (`🛢️db/🗿️artifact` `grade_conflict_record`). A batch refused for a history transition (`history.malformed-transition`, `history.unknown-target`, `history.transition-refused`) names that refusal alone, as an error whose notice code is the raw code (byte-equal with the wgpu shell); every other hub refusal is a warning coded `sync.command.rejected`. A local refusal is told by its own code. `notice` is the exact notice text per locale; no producer's English `reason` appears in it.
